notes_for_editor: Only the two FFLA lists have anything on this tower, and they agree. Two web searches found no other Timberland tower record. The Wikipedia page for the Timberland community came back as raw wikitext and is not cited; no source ties the tower to the community name. Coordinates are the association's and were not checked against a map. The story is short because the evidence is thin; a Burnett County or Wisconsin DNR source would be needed to add history.
